payload.body: ISSUE:0002 live check, with hv's OK, at 10:05Z: 812264d's release build (sha256 0f4a3d2b) ran usage --all on hv's five accounts. It exited 0 in 4s with nothing on stderr, and every account showed usage fetched under a minute earlier. No token was due, so nothing was renewed: login.keychain-db metadata is identical before and after (215 records, all 13 Claude items unchanged in partitions, decrypt apps and mdat). So the reads through security pass live without a prompt. The renewal half stays with Acceptance 5's check after 0.1.6 is installed, and CI with the next push of main. Your hold 3 can go.
